OGF-GFX 1
# What the "Graphics" page of Divine Divinity can change (data, not code). Format: src/Gfx.cs (GfxDef.Parse).
#   slot=id|kind|title.ru|title.en|desc.ru|desc.en        kind: sets (choice among asset sets) | window (opens a window) | scale | render
#   opt=slot|value|setId[?]|name.ru|name.en|preview[+preview2]|approxMb|patch   (setId ending in @ui = one set per interface skin; patch = id of a patch= table that goes with the option)
#      "?" after the set id = shown only when the server offers the set
#   fix=id|kind|arg|name.ru|name.en|desc.ru|desc.en|flags   kind: dusk | floor | floorsaves | bytes (arg = patch id); flags (comma separated): default (applied by default) | switch (default AND a switch on the page) | cli (command line only)
#   patch=id|file|size|hexoffset:original:patched|...      every point is checked against the expected bytes before anything is written
#      |append0:N   = a zero tail of N bytes added at the END of the file (patch=frame: the PE sections .cave/.glow/.interp). |needs:ID = the patch writes into the tail of patch ID (Core.SetBytePatch puts the frame in before the first and takes it out after the last);
#      |append:HEX  = legacy form of a tail with content (patch=interp_legacy, unreleased test builds); every patch of the file accepts size, size+tail of the frame and size+legacy tail
#      point `off:orig:pat~alt` = a second patched variant (the language dependent label of the big windows: pat = Russian, alt = English)
#   cmpentry=file|entry|orig hex|new hex   (same size)  and  textrec=file|table|id|text ru|text other   = data edits switched together with patch=windows (src/WinPack.cs)
game=divine-divinity

slot=pic|sets|Апскейлинг|Upscaling|Нейросеть очищает все спрайты игры|A neural network cleans all the game sprites
opt=pic|orig||Оригинал|Original|inv_orig+dlg_orig
opt=pic|v2|clean-v2|Чистая v2|Clean v2|inv_v2+dlg_v21|472

slot=ui|sets|Интерфейс|Interface|Окна, рамки и кнопки: один скин за раз|Windows, frames and buttons: one skin at a time
opt=ui|orig||Оригинал|Original|inv_orig+dlg_orig
opt=ui|e|skin-e|Перерисованный|Redrawn|inv_E+dlg_E|27
opt=ui|a|skin-a|Пергамент|Parchment|inv_A+dlg_A|27
opt=ui|b|skin-b|Тёмный металл|Dark metal|inv_B+dlg_B|27
opt=ui|c|skin-c|Оригинал HD|Original HD|inv_C+dlg_C|10
opt=ui|d|skin-d|Тёмное стекло|Dark glass|inv_D+dlg_D|26

slot=items|sets|Предметы|Items|Рисунки оружия, брони и вещей|Pictures of weapons, armour and things
opt=items|orig||Оригинал|Original|inv_orig+dlg_orig
opt=items|hd|items-hd|Оригинал HD|Original HD|inv_itemsHD+dlg_orig|5
opt=items|redrawn|items-redrawn|Перерисованные|Redrawn|inv_itemsRedrawn+dlg_orig|81
hide=items|hd

slot=bag|sets|Крупные окна|Large windows|Рюкзак, торговля и характеристики крупнее, кнопка сортировки|Backpack, trade and stats windows bigger, sort button
opt=bag|orig||Обычные|Normal|inv_orig+dlg_orig
opt=bag|big|windows-@ui|Крупные|Large|inv_orig+dlg_orig|10|windows

slot=fonts|window|Шрифты|Fonts|Крупный текст, книги, диалоги|Larger text, books, dialogues
slot=scale|scale|Размер интерфейса|Interface size|Масштаб всего кадра (нужен gr-draw)|Scale of the whole picture (needs gr-draw)
slot=render|render|Рендер|Renderer|gr-draw или dgVoodoo|gr-draw or dgVoodoo

fix=floor|floor||Дыра пола в подвале|Cellar floor hole|Чёрный прямоугольник у ящиков (новая игра)|The black patch next to the crates (new game)|default
fix=floorsaves|floorsaves||…и в моих сохранениях|…and in my saves|Та же правка карты в уже сделанных сохранениях|The same map fix inside the saves you already have|cli
fix=automap|bytes|automap|Панель карты внизу|Map panel at the bottom|Кнопки автокарты у нижнего края экрана|Automap buttons at the bottom edge of the screen|default
fix=glow|bytes|glow|Подсветка предметов|Item glow|Ореол у редких предметов в рюкзаке и цветные подписи Alt|Halo on rare items in the backpack and coloured Alt labels|default,switch

# Data of "Large windows" that is NOT shipped in the sets (generated by tools/make_windows_sets.py), switched together with patch=windows:
#   cmpentry=<cmp file>|<entry>|<original hex>|<new hex>   replaces an entry of a .cmp container IN PLACE (same size): the character-stats layout (the game reads dat\statuspl.cmp from dat\global.cmp)
#   textrec=<cmp file, * = any folder>|<table>|<id>|<text ru, cp1251>|<text other>   adds a string to text.cmp: the tooltip of the Sort button (the text is chosen by the language of the file)
cmpentry=dat\global.cmp|dat\statuspl.cmp||
textrec=localizations\*\text.cmp|10000|772|Сортировать|Sort
